verdict.rationale: Gusto is a SaaS payroll and HR platform that handles sensitive customer data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documented setting, policy or contractual control that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The robots.txt Content-Signal marker is about web crawlers reading gusto.com, not customer data, so it is at most an adjacent signal and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
